🌑 Node One Build Recommendation
A Hi-Fidelity Mythic Listening System (Portable 2.1 Edition)

🧊 1. Full-Range Tops (Stereo Clarity Portals)
🪶 Function:
Deliver extreme stereo imaging, transient clarity, and vocal fidelity across a wide range of textures (Burial to G Jones to DJ Screw)

📐 Design:
2-way ported or sealed enclosure

6.5”–8” high-sensitivity mid-woofer (Faital Pro 6FE200, SB Acoustics, or Dayton RS180)

1” compression driver + waveguide (B&C DE10 or similar) or a high-quality soft dome tweeter for smoother top-end

Enclosure: ~10–15 liters sealed or tuned ported with heavy bracing

🔁 Future Upgrades:
Add passive radiator or horn waveguide

Replace tweeter with ribbon or AMT for more surgical detail

Stackable horn-loaded mid-high expansion


🌊 2. Subwoofer (Infra Portal Root)
🌋 Function:
Deliver felt-not-heard bass from 25–35Hz with minimal distortion

Keep bass tactile and warm for chopped & screwed, glitch, jungle

📐 Design:
Tapped Horn or Extended Reflex Enclosure

Driver: 15”–18” high-Xmax woofer
 (Options: Dayton HO460, B&C 15TBX100, Eminence Lab 15)

Cabinet design options:

THAM15 (tapped horn) for high-efficiency small-room use

Microwrecker or Tuba 24 for DIY infrasonic performance

Custom large reflex with ultra-low tuning

🔁 Future Upgrades:
Add a second sub for stereo or cardioid config

Integrate sealed subs for ultra-tight low-end


🎛 3. Amplification & Crossover (Soul Splitter)
💡 Starter Setup:
Behringer NX1000D / NX3000D (Class D with DSP)

Or: clean used stereo amp + MiniDSP 2x4 HD

🧠 DSP Roles:
Set crossover (~80–120Hz)

EQ room response

Limiters for driver safety


🔌 4. Input / Ritual Console (Signal Shrine)
Rotary DJ mixer or minimalist mixer for vinyl / instrument integration

Optional effects loop (reverb, delay, tape)


🧩 Modular Evolution Plan

🔮 Symbolic Design Direction (Optional Guidance)
Visual metaphor: Chrysalis of Sound
 → outer wood shell with geometric grillwork, inner light pulse behind the speaker cones

Color palette: gunmetal, amethyst, deep violet, glitch white

A name etched or sigil-burned into the wood for Node One


🛠 Estimated Cost (Starter Tier – DIY + Scavenged)
